description: Step 2: sends the request signed by the agent's own wallet to a Recta route and returns its HTTP status and JSON body. POST /v1/golden-corridor/commercial-evaluations returns, free, the cheapest provable route against the route the agent would use anyway, or an abstention. Executing a decision's route creates a fee of 5 % of the verified saving, capped by the permit the agent signs; no saving, no fee.
name: recta_send_signed_request
title: Send a signed request to Recta
